dedupe_keys.name: nis public transport data and gtfs feed data gov rs

description: The City of Niš publishes on the Serbian open data portal a dataset on all city public transport lines, timetables, stop locations, routes and fares, including a GTFS feed. The dataset page explains GTFS and lists the files in the feed (agency, stops, routes, trips, stop times, calendar and calendar dates, fare attributes and rules, shapes, frequencies, transfers, pathways, levels and feed info), with stop attributes such as identifier, name, direction, lines and zone. Resources are a 2026 GTFS zip file updated on 21 January 2026 and stop and route layers in GeoJSON and CSV from 2022. The dataset was created in 2019, is updated irregularly, and is published under the Serbian open data licence (sodl) shown in the portal metadata. Access is free and open, with no registration. Caveats: the stop and route layers are older than the GTFS feed, and the descriptions are in Serbian. Coverage is the city of Niš. It supports network flow and capacity planning of urban public transport, and exposure analysis of stops and routes; related records are the Croatian transport registers on the MMPI open data pages and the Luxembourg national road traffic counts.
